scope: Agent environment measurements; full startup on the user browser remains unmeasured.

initial_template_tree.count_definition: Static anvil-component declarations including recursively embedded app Forms; excludes repeated data items, Material 3 internals, and DOM nodes.

http.scope: Compressed document requests from agent network; excludes JavaScript execution and browser rendering. Asset results use the document base URL.
http.interpretation: No document-download improvement demonstrated; these changes reduce client construction work. Separate requests are affected by network and cache conditions.

server_execution.scope: Five direct server executions; excludes browser, RPC transport and cold runtime startup.

browser.status: Awaiting a real browser report; the agent environment has no browser automation.
browser.ready_frame: navigation_ms.ready_frame is milliseconds from frame navigation to a paint opportunity after the requested page is ready.
browser.paint: browser_paint_ms contains native browser paint entries when available. These can include the Anvil runtime loading screen.
browser.phase_note: analysis_apply is nested inside saved_portfolio_restore; do not sum those durations.
browser.values_frame: navigation_ms.values_frame is milliseconds from navigation to a paint opportunity after saved totals and holdings are visible, before full chart history finishes.

verification.live_navigation: Passed bootstrap, saved restore, profile/planning/inbox/billing preload, no market/SEC calls or planner writes, cross-account and anonymous denial; temporary fixtures removed.
verification.saved_values_startup: Passed exact summary/metrics/holdings equivalence, one directory query, no market-history fetch, current classifications, explicit links, empty/unsynced portfolios, navigation ordering, edit invalidation, deletion and account isolation. Temporary fixtures removed.
verification.persistent_overview_cache: Passed exact value equivalence, legacy allocation normalization, absent timestamp support, one-time upgrade, rename reuse, late-backfill rejection, sector overrides, edit/rate/date invalidation, staged-analysis save, deletion and account isolation. Temporary fixtures removed.

changes: Saved analysis restores without constructing transaction editors; editors warm after main views and are reused until their data changes.
Quarterly share details are mounted once on expansion; visible share bars and accessible summaries remain immediately available.
Holdings calculations reuse quarter keys within each month, avoid reparsing saved numbers, and skip FIFO bookkeeping on unchanged days.

calculation_benchmark.measurement: Local CPython, 9 samples per case; not browser timing

additional_efficiency_pass.benchmark_method: Nine alternating before/after samples per case after warmup, using deterministic five-year fixtures with purchases, sales and a split. All historical quarter results were compared for exact equality.
additional_efficiency_pass.transaction_restore_test: Zero editor list assignments during saved-analysis restore; one during preparation or first Edit; retained across tab changes.
additional_efficiency_pass.browser_startup: Unmeasured in this environment; local calculations and component counts do not establish total browser startup time.

changes: One authenticated startup request returns shared account metadata and the current saved totals, returns and holdings.
Daily chart history follows in a deferred request after the visible saved values have a paint opportunity.
The first response seeds the metadata cache for retained pages; no extra account metadata round trip.
Editing and chart navigation wait for the complete history; current holdings filters work immediately.

changes: Store current summary, metrics and holdings with each saved analysis in the private analysis_overview column.
Reuse that summary on startup without decompressing or parsing the full history.
Upgrade older summary versions once on opening, with fingerprint and timestamp checks against concurrent edits or refreshes.
Apply current account sector choices to the small saved snapshot.
Retain visible holdings rows and reuse the server-computed latest quarter when full history arrives.

comparison.method: Seven alternating before/after startup executions against the same portfolio and runtime. The before implementation reconstructs the overview from full saved history.

persistent_overview_cache.client_verification: Form logic tests verified zero new holdings/activity item assignments and zero latest-quarter calculations during an unchanged snapshot handoff. Changed values update the rows while preserving filters. Historical quarter navigation still works.
persistent_overview_cache.live_verification: Passed exact value equivalence, legacy allocation normalization, absent timestamp support, one-time upgrade, rename reuse, late-backfill rejection, sector overrides, edit/rate/date invalidation, staged-analysis save, deletion and account isolation. Temporary fixtures removed.
persistent_overview_cache.browser_startup: End-to-end browser latency and visual behavior remain unmeasured in this environment.
persistent_overview_cache.existing_portfolio_note: Older saved portfolios build the compact cache on their first opening. Subsequent openings use it directly.

changes: Start the compact saved-values request before importing and constructing the dashboard.
Reuse the completed or in-flight response when the dashboard attaches, with cancellation for obsolete account and portfolio routes.
Build closed trading-activity items after the visible holdings, then prepare them in the background for opening.
Record values_request_during_page_build and values_wait_after_page_build in the browser startup report.

checks.client_behavior: Passed fast and slow response delivery, one startup request, queued route replacement, account changes, failure cleanup, deferred activity rendering, quarter changes, empty activity, and reuse after background preparation.
checks.live_behavior: Passed saved values and full history equivalence, one directory query, no market-history fetch before values, legacy cache upgrades, rename reuse, late-backfill protection, sector overrides, edit invalidation, unavailable portfolios and account isolation. Temporary benchmark fixtures removed.
